line: We all begin with questions late nights blank screens eyes staring into glowing blue uncertainty
Searches spiral Pages blur Career options multiply but none of them feel right
He writes Scratches it out Tries again But everything feels wrong like someone elses map
The world wakes He hasnt slept Just stared hoping for something anything to feel right
Outside the world screams promises Fasttrack careers Guaranteed futures But they all sound the same
He sits in another class Words drone on None of it connects None of it feels like his future
In a world filled with noise how do you find direction
A new name Polaris One hes never seen before But it pulls him in
For the first time it doesnt sound like noise It feels like a signal
